# 02 Give generated sequence ids a colon separator

## Outcome

A box grouping's id is `box:1` and a control-flow block's is `loop:1` / `alt:2` / `rect:1`. No
message id can spell one, so no two elements in a sequence diagram share a `data-siren-id`.

## Why this ticket exists

`buildSequenceModel` builds `box-${n}` (`buildSequenceModel.ts:136`) and `${kind}-${n}`
(`:316`) with a hyphen, and a message's id is `${from}-${to}`. Participant ids are `\w+`, so
`box->>1: hi` yields the message id `box-1` — the same string the document's first box grouping
holds. `svg.querySelectorAll('[data-siren-id="box-1"]')` then matches both, with no diagnostic to
say anything is wrong.

`buildClassModel` already answered this, and its reasoning transfers verbatim: `-` is spoken for by
the connector-id convention, a colon cannot occur in a `\w+` id, so the separator makes the
collision structurally impossible instead of merely unlikely. See its `ID_SEPARATOR` comment at
`buildClassModel.ts:95`.

Doing it now rather than after ticket 03 is deliberate: these ids ship in `data-siren-id` today,
but nothing can address them until a `timeline:` block can. This is the last moment the change
costs nothing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Box ids are `box:1`, `box:2`, ... in declaration order.
- [x] Block ids are `${kind}:${n}` for all seven kinds — `loop:1`, `alt:1`, `opt:1`, `par:1`,
      `critical:1`, `break:1`, `rect:1` — with the per-kind 1-based counter and document-order
      numbering unchanged.
- [x] Message ids are **unchanged**: `${from}-${to}`, then `#2` for a repeat pair. This ticket does
      not touch the connector convention.
- [x] A test asserts the collision is gone: a document with `box Blue` grouping a participant
      `box`, and a message `box->>1: hi` (participant `1`), produces two distinct ids, and the
      rendered SVG has exactly one element per id where it had two.
- [x] The separator is a named constant with the reason attached, not an inline `":"`, mirroring
      `buildClassModel`'s `ID_SEPARATOR`.
- [x] Existing tests that assert `box-1` / `loop-1` are updated to the new spelling — in
      `buildSequenceModel.test.ts`, `layoutSequence.test.ts`, `renderSequenceToSVG.test.ts` and
      `index.test.ts`. Grep for `"box-` and `"loop-` before declaring this done.

## Test seam

`buildSequenceModel` for the ids themselves; `render()` for the collision claim, since the
duplicate only becomes visible in the DOM.
